meta.note: Zenki — Temporal Enforcement Service. Distinct from the Rust Brood Zenki and zenki_brain.rs cognitive loop.

identity: Identify and de-prioritize background processes that violate temporal predictability.

loop.observe: Scans all processes (pid/name/cpu). XP in Logging (6).
loop.process: Flags anomaly-list processes (cortana, searchapp, onedrive) above 5% CPU. XP in Leatherworking (10).
loop.execute: Sets violators to idle priority. XP in Armoring (15).

system_role: Enforcer brain for guardian micro agents — the one that trims what violates predictability. Feeds the Watchdog maintainer.
